content.short: Holograph is an omnichain NFT protocol on Mantle enabling NFTs to move natively between blockchains while preserving their token contract address.
content.description: Holograph is a pioneering omnichain NFT infrastructure protocol that enables truly portable NFTs  tokens that can move between blockchains while maintaining the same contract address and token ID across all networks. Unlike bridge-based NFT solutions that create wrapped copies, Holograph burns tokens on the source chain and mints identical tokens on the destination chain, ensuring authenticity and contract-level consistency. This technology is deployed on Mantle, enabling Mantle NFT projects to offer their holders genuine multi-chain portability.
content.meta: Holograph enables native omnichain NFT portability across blockchains including Mantle, preserving contract addresses. Discover Holograph on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
